sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite their league-leading position, Sandbach have experienced a dip in form with their most recent result being a loss, though they remain strong with seven wins in their last six outings. They face a struggling Alsager Town side bottom of the division with just four points, giving Sandbach a strong opportunity to bounce back.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to maintain their challenge after a recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of two in-form sides—AFC Bridgnorth sit third after consecutive recent wins, while Eccleshall occupy fifth and have won their last match. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in good form with recent wins, entertain struggling Wednesfield Community. The weekend features several mismatches: Bilston Town (sixth, strong form) host Foley Meir (mid-table), while New Mills (eighth) travel to Market Drayton Town (tenth), a clash between sides competing in the lower reaches. Brereton Social face Widnes Town, the division's bottom side with just two points. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement battle, with both sides among the poorest performers. Shawbury United, on an alarming run of six consecutive losses, host Barnton in a test of character. Crewe, inconsistent and struggling, face Allscott Heath who have shown recent signs of recovery.
